A [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]]<ref name="CSWE" /> [[Gender/Legends|male]] was a '''member''' of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]<ref name="Being Boba Fett" /> during [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]. In that [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="Date" /> the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]]<ref name="Being Boba Fett" /> on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]]<ref name="GATORW">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref> occurred.<ref name="Being Boba Fett" /> Both he<ref name="Being Boba Fett" /> and the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] were causalities of the battle.<ref name="db">{{DB|character|jangofett|Fett, Jango}}</ref> Before the Twi'lek died, however, he had [[Parent/Legends|fathered]] a Twi'lek [[Unidentified Twi'lek Jedi's son|son]] who had to live life without him.<ref name="Being Boba Fett" />

During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]], the Jedi's son had a [[Unidentified Twi'lek Jedi's grandson|child]] and a house on a [[Unidentified planet (Bendu Fry)|planet]], where it was rumored that he was a Jedi himself. The bounty hunter [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]], son of Jango Fett, tracked down the Jedi's son, intent on collecting on the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] bounty on Jedi.<ref name="Being Boba Fett" />
